svg.title: CORDE Mobile, an offline-first React Native field-log app for CORDE’s maintenance crews, built in 2024 by a Lincoln University industry-placement team with Chan Meng as Full Stack Developer and Lead Documenter. Eight stills from the product film’s coded replica of the app: sign in to six tools, search and open a job, submit a finished job, save a new log with no signal, background sync, sync a date range, jobs as map pins, and group completion. Chan’s part, June to November 2024: 236 of 413 commits in the original app repository (57%, the largest share of three contributors) and 140 of 143 commits in the documentation repository (97.9%). A teammate took the project over in 2024.
